intuition.title: Washing removes residual surfactant
intuition.text: For one comparison batch, elemental C/H falls from9.26/1.69wt% after one toluene wash to3.93/0.72wt% after toluene/methanol washing. FTIR supports removal of AOT. The typical preparation instead uses repeated sonication with toluene, ethanol and hexane, followed by TOP treatment; those sequences remain distinct. C/H is not a quantitative ligand coverage.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
